programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: A three part dramatised documentary series examining the one of England's most famous Kings: Henry VIII. The series chronicles his life from young man up to his monstrous later years. After becoming heir to the throne following his elder brother's unexpected death, a young Prince Henry also lost his mother, adding to a growing list of personal tragedy. We follow the young King on his journey as ruler, including the infamous power battle with the Catholic Church and the pursuit of English Reformation, enabling him to re-marry. His extravagant diet that led to many health complications is revealed, as the once fit and athletic King became obese and unhealthy in his later life, adding to his cruel and paranoid character.

programme.title: The meaning: LaLiga Genuine
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: From the National Geographic, this documentary series explores the deadliest animals that inhabit out planet. programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: A national Geographic documentary looking into the deadliest animals that roam Africa. Examining animals that have evolved complex weapons from teeth to claws and agility so that they can protect themselves and battle effectively. From elephant tusks that can defend or attack to the fur, speed and agility of seals. Showing how these animals have exceptional skills and power alongside their body features that have developed into ideal tools for their needs.

programme.title: When Predators Attack
programme.desc: This docuseries detais what happens when predators come face to face with their prey and humans and reveals the reasons why dangerous encounters take place and the best way for people to avoid them or to make a quick escape if necessary. Each one hour long episode focuses on a specifice animal including formidable killer snakes that use deadly venom or constriction to defeat their opponent; black bears, grizzlies, and giant polar bears who are increasingly encroaching into human territory because of climate change and are confronting more humans; and the most ancient of predators, the crocodile.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Killer Three
programme.desc: This series looks at the natural born killers of the animal kingdom with each episode focusing on a particular, shared aspect of what makes these creatures successful predators. In 'Little Killers', we see how a lack of physical size can be overcome when hunting prey and miniscule attackers are able to bring down prey that are massive in comparison. In 'Speed Kills', the spotlight is shone on those predators who use their incredibly fast skills to catch their food. From the fastest animal on land, the cheetah, to the stargazer fish that dispatches its prey in a tenth of a second to the deadly black mamba, some of these attacks are so fast that they cannot be captured using slow-motion. In 'Hunger Games', the emphasis is placed on the driving force behind the majority of attacks, the desire for food.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion v Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. From the fastest animal on land, the cheetah, to the stargazer fish that dispatches its prey in a tenth of a second to the deadly black mamba, some of these attacks are so fast that they cannot be captured using slow-motion. In 'Hunger Games', the emphasis is placed on the driving force behind the majority of attacks, the desire for food.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion v Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: When Predators Attack

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: British author, television presenter and wildlife expert, Nigel Marven, travels the world to find the deadliest species of snake. In each episode Marven travels to a new country or continent and reveals the top 10 deadliest snakes that inhabit that region. From Costa Rica's black-headed bushmaster to South Africa's infamous black mamba, China's king cobra to Mexico's terciopelo, we uncover the most dangerous snakes on our planet. Known for his bold and impulsive approach to animals in the wild, Marven must be on full alert, as a bite from these slithering serpents could paralyse or even kill him.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Built to Survive

In the leafy canopy, Phil encounters the elusive tree kangaroo and its young joey, as well as Australia's largest snake, the lethal scrub python. On the forest floor, the colorful cassowary acts as the rainforest's gardener.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Within the Channel Country deserts, Indigenous educator Phil Breslin scours the endless sands to find three animals that not only survive the heat but thrive in unrelenting conditions. Get ready to meet Australia's most impressive animals: the perentie, the continent's largest lizard; the emu, its fastest flightless bird; and the mighty red kangaroo, the world's largest marsupial.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin ventures into Australia's notorious wetlands to discover three animals built for the muggy and wet environment. Phil comes face to face with the uniquely Australian freshwater crocodile, a massive predatory fish called the barramundi, and the saltwater crocodile, one of the world's most dangerous animals and largest reptiles.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads along the cliffs and sandy flats of the Australian coast to discover which animal dominates the shoreline. His first encounter is with a white -bellied sea eagle, a bird with extremely sharp talons, followed by the estuarine stonefish, the most venomous fish in the world. Finally, Phil takes a closer look at the notorious stingray.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads into the mangroves to discover which animal is truly built to survive the mud and muck. He encounters a feisty mud crab with huge pincers and catches a shovel-nosed ray with his bare hands. Finally, Phil faces a creature we all love to hate—the mosquito—and discovers there's more to these tiny bloodsuckers than meets the eye.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads to the mysterious blue depths to discover which animal dominates the sea. His first encounter is with a tiger shark, the notorious hunter shaped like a torpedo and armed with ferocious teeth! Next, Phil dives with a group of magnificent manta rays and listens to the songs of one of the largest creatures on Earth, the majestic humpback whale.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin leaves the Australian mainland to discover which of the island-dwelling animals is truly built to survive. First up, he meets the enigmatic green turtle on the Wellesley Islands. Next, he is on K'Gari (Fraser Island), where he tracks down a pack of the notorious dingoes. Finally, he encounters the formidable and aptly named death adder snake.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin dares into the Australian savannah to find the species most built to survive. Finally, Phil faces the uniquely Australian frill-necked lizard, a reptile with fascinating defense mechanisms.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia's rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia's woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: Wallykazam! is about the adventures of Wally Trollman and his pet dragon, Norville. Wally has a magic stick that makes words come to life; each story has a new set of magic words, and Wally uses these words to playfully transform the world around him.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: The Curse of King Mutt:Protecting the King Mutt exhibit at the Natural History Museum from all the fiends who want to steal King Mutt's jewel encrusted bone scepter proves to be a lot more challenging than Dudley and Kitty expected. Especially because Dudley can't fight his uncontrollable urge to bury it!Bored of Education:Playing it safe at Career Day turns out to be the most dangerous thing Dudley and Kitty ever do! When the Chameleon entices an entire class of first graders into a life of crime, Dudley and Kitty must convince them that even though being a good guy means following the rules, it's always way cooler than being bad!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks hinges on David Seville, a single father whose everyday struggle is to bring up his kids, 3 chipmunks: Alvin- the oldest brother, the leader, not so good at school, Simon- the smartest of the three brothers, exemplary pupil and Theodore- the youngest one, the chubby one, the gentle one. David "Dave" sometimes loses his temper and then he is shouting "Alvinnnnn!!!". Music is an obligatory pleasant part of every episode. Every episode touches up-to-date issues of both adults and kids from modern life like real problems at school, dating and so on. Thanks to their own foolishness chipmunks often find themselves in ridiculous situations and have to use their creativity to get out of a mess, that provides us with a good opportunity to enjoy their joyful adventures.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Loud House

Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

Dan Gallagher, un avvocato di New York felicemente sposato, tradisce la moglie con una sconosciuta, che non si accontenta di una sola notte e comincia a perseguitarlo rendendogli la vita un inferno. Le provocazioni della psicopatica si fanno sempre piu' asfissianti, fino a quando la donna comunica a Dan di essere incinta, rifiutandosi di abortire. La sua prossima sfida sara' recarsi a casa dell'uomo per conoscere la moglie...

programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Emilia Perez

3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.desc: 5 Oscar a un film simbolo degli anni 90, con Kevin Spacey e Annette Bening, diretti da Sam Mendes. Un quarantenne insoddisfatto si invaghisce di una compagna di scuola di sua figlia.

programme.desc: Western con Brad Pitt - premiato a Venezia - e Casey Affleck. Inseguito dai cacciatori di taglie, il fuorilegge Jesse James deve guardarsi da un traditore.

programme.desc: Henry Fonda e Claudia Cardinale nel western che ha consacrato il mito di Sergio Leone. Un magnate delle ferrovie ingaggia un killer per impadronirsi del terreno di un'ex prostituta.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

programme.title: Cena con delitto - Knives Out
programme.desc: Daniel Craig e un super cast in una movimentata commedia-thriller. Un detective indaga sulla famiglia di un ricco scrittore per scoprirne l'assassino.

programme.desc: Crimini, colpe e inganni con Jane Wyman e Marlen Dietrich nel thriller di Alfred Hitchcock. Il marito di una diva teatrale scompare e i sospetti ricadono sull'amante della donna.

I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Pierfrancesco Favino e Miriam Leone in una commedia brillante e dissacrante. Gianni e' un seduttore seriale, ma l'incontro con Chiara cambiera' tutto.

programme.desc: Spumeggiante commedia romantica con Jennifer Aniston, Ben Affleck, Jennifer Connelly e Scarlett Johansson. A Baltimora si intrecciano le vicende amorose di un gruppo di donne.

Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.desc: Colpo grosso a Las Vegas per George Clooney, Brad Pitt e un cast di stelle. Un ex galeotto raduna dieci complici per rapinare un caveau nella capitale del gioco d'azzardo.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: Un fantastico via vai
programme.desc: Leonardo Pieraccioni nel mondo dei 'laureati' in una commedia con Serena Autieri. Cacciato dalla moglie, un quarantenne si ritrova a condividere un appartamento con quattro studenti.

programme.title: Maschi contro femmine
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi, Fabio De Luigi e Alessandro Preziosi nella commedia sbanca-botteghino di Fausto Brizzi che intreccia storie di crisi sentimentali, tradimenti e ricerca della felicità.

programme.title: Qualunquemente
programme.desc: Antonio Albanese nei panni dello spassoso Cetto La Qualunque. Tornato in Italia dopo un periodo di latitanza, Cetto si candida a sindaco per difendere le sue proprieta' dalla... legalita'.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: Torna il super cast diretto da Steven Soderbergh nel sequel di "Ocean's Eleven". Per restituire i soldi del primo colpo, gli undici di Ocean sono costretti ad organizzare 3 colpi in Europa.

programme.title: Il campione
programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Mollami
programme.desc: Road movie targato Sky Original diretto da Matteo Gentiloni. Un’adolescente problematica viene costretta dal padre ad andare in collegio, ma il viaggio non sarà semplice.

programme.title: (Im)perfetti criminali - Backstage - Speciale
programme.desc: Sul set del nuovo imprevedibile Sky Original. Il regista Alessio Maria Federici ci porta alla scoperta dei protagonisti e delle scene piu' divertenti di questo spericolato action-movie.

programme.title: Febbre da cavallo - La mandrakata
programme.desc: Carlo Vanzina dirige Gigi Proietti ed Enrico Montesano nel sequel del cult degli anni 70. Ancora accanito scommettitore, Mandrake coinvolge un gruppo di buffi complici in una truffa.

programme.title: E' stato il figlio
programme.desc: Toni Servillo in una vicenda grottesca di Daniele Cipri'. Dopo la morte della figlia, una famiglia palermitana spende il risarcimento in una Mercedes. L'automobile segnera' la loro rovina.

programme.title: Brave ragazze
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Serena Rossi, Ilenia Pastorelli e Silvia D’Amico nella commedia diretta da Michela Andreozzi. Quattro ragazze di Gaeta si travestono da uomini per rapinare una banca.

programme.title: Tutti per 1 - 1 per tutti
programme.desc: Tornano i moschettieri Pierfrancesco Favino, Valerio Mastandrea, Rocco Papaleo, assieme alla regina Margherita Buy, diretti da Giovanni Veronesi nel primo film targato Sky Original.

programme.title: Un anno difficile
programme.desc: La coppia di registi di "Quasi amici" torna con una commedia attuale. Due uomini indebitati cercano di sopravvivere con astuzia, entrando a far parte di un gruppo di attivisti.

programme.title: Benvenuti in casa Esposito
programme.desc: Prodotta da Alessandro Siani, commedia di Gianluca Ansanelli con Giovanni Esposito e Antonia Truppo, ispirata al libro di Pino Imperatore. Alla morte di un boss camorrista, il figlio, incapace di seguirne le orme, si cimenta in goffi tentativi di riscossione del pizzo.

programme.title: Yes Man
programme.desc: Jim Carrey sfoggia la sua comicità in una graffiante commedia. Insoddisfatto della sua vita, un uomo abbraccia una nuova filosofia che segue una semplice ma pericolosa regola.

programme.title: Moschettieri del re: La penultima missione
programme.desc: Giovanni Veronesi dirige Piefrancesco Favino, Sergio Rubini, Rocco Papaleo e Valerio Mastandrea nella commedia sulle nuove imprese dei tre moschettieri e D'Artagnan.

programme.title: Una notte da leoni
programme.desc: Notte brava a Las Vegas per Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms e Zach Galifianakis. Per rintracciare il promesso sposo scomparso i suoi amici ripercorrono le tappe della folle notte appena trascorsa.

programme.title: Hazzard
programme.desc: Jessica Simpson, Burt Reynolds e Johnny Knoxville nella commedia ispirata alla serie cult degli anni 80. I cugini Bo e Luke Duke cercano di contrastare i piani criminali di Boss Hogg.

programme.title: Cetto c'e', senzadubbiamente
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo di successo per il carismatico personaggio di Antonio Albanese. La vita di Cetto in Germania e' scossa dalla rivelazione della zia morente: e' l'erede naturale di un principe.

programme.title: Il vegetale
programme.desc: Gennaro Nunziante ('Quo Vado?) dirige Fabio Rovazzi in una commedia sui nostri tempi. Alla ricerca del primo impiego, un ambizioso neolaureato affronta una serie di comiche vicissitudini.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Io sono...
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci portano alla scoperta del film di Angelo Duro acclamato dal pubblico, dal 10 giugno in programmazione su Sky Cinema.

programme.title: Maggie Moore(s) - Un omicidio di troppo
programme.desc: Commedia a tinte gialle targata Sky Original con Jon Hamm e Tina Fey. In una polverosa citta' dell'Arizona, il capo della polizia si trova alle prese con gli omicidi di due donne omonime.

programme.title: Premier League - La vera storia
programme.desc: Uno dei momenti piu' iconici e' quando Eric Cantona si lancia tra la folla e scalcia un tifoso del Crystal Palace. La lotta per il titolo e' aperta.

programme.title: Bayer Leverkusen - Bayern Monaco
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League: Bayer Leverkusen - Bayern Monaco. Ottavi di Finale Ritorno - Rossoneri per ritrovare i quarti di Champions dopo quelli del 2002. Bayern a un passo dai quarti per la sesta volta consecutiva dopo il 3-0 dell’andata. TC: Pietro Nicolodi.

programme.title: Ep.3
programme.desc: Ep3 - In questa puntata diamo uno sguardo a quattro dei piu' illustri allenatore che hanno vinto la UEFA Champions League: Benitez, Hitzfeld, Van Gaal e Del Bosque.

programme.title: Barcellona - Borussia Dortmund
programme.desc: Entrambe le formazioni ai quarti di Champions per la seconda stagione consecutiva. Nelle 5 precedenti sfide europee, 3 vittorie del Barcellona e 2 pareggi. TC: Antonio Nucera.

programme.title: Ep. 6
programme.desc: Alla scoperta dei giovani talenti maschili e femminili del nostro calcio attraverso i racconti e le conduzioni dei protagonisti dei settori giovanili italiani.

programme.title: Liverpool, Simply The Best
programme.desc: La colonna sonora della splendida stagione del Liverpool in Premier League: abbiamo selezionato i brani che raccontano i gol di tutti i marcatori dei Reds, a partire da Mo Salah.

programme.title: Juventus - Fiorentina
programme.desc: Serie A: Juventus - Fiorentina. 18a g. - Bianconeri tornati al successo (1-2 a Monza). Hanno vinto 10 degli ultimi 11 precedenti a Torino, un ko. Viola reduci da 2 ko di fila (Bologna e Udinese). TC: Marinozzi-Dzemaili.

programme.title: Juventus - Real Madrid 03/06/17
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Story: Juventus - Real Madrid 2017. Finale - Riviviamo i momenti piu' esaltanti di questa competizione attraverso le partite piu' interessanti. Buon divertimento!

programme.title: Lecce - Inter
programme.desc: Serie A: Lecce - Inter. 22a g. - Giallorossi reduci dal ko di Cagliari (4-1). +1 sulla terzultima. Inter seconda con una gara in meno. Solo 3 ko a Lecce nei 20 precedenti, 12 vittorie e 5 pari. TC: Zancan-Minotti.

programme.title: Ep. 3
programme.desc: Ep2 - Riviviamo le grandi sfide della Champions League attraverso le immagini e le voci dei protagonisti di due rimonte epiche nella storia di questo torneo: M. United-Bayern Monaco e Liverpool-Milan.

programme.title: Brighton - Arsenal
programme.desc: Premier League: Brentford - Arsenal. 20a g. - Biancoblù senza vittorie da 7 giornate, 5 pari e 2 ko. Arsenal imbattuto da 9 turni. -6 dal Liverpool. Ha vinto 3 delle ultime 4 sfide di Premier a Brighton. TC: Massimo Marianella.

programme.title: Premier League - La vera storia
programme.desc: e' la meta' degli anni '90, la Premier League cresce sempre piu' e una nuova generazione di giocatori impara a gestire la neo trovata fama.

programme.title: Paris - Bayern M. 2020
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Story: Paris - Bayern Monaco 2020. Finale - Un club francese in finale mancava dal 2004 (Monaco), poi sconfitto dal Porto. Il Bayern torna a disputare una finale di Champions dopo 7 anni. TC: Trevisani-Adani.

programme.title: Paris - Inter
programme.desc: Nerazzurri per la seconda Champions, dopo quella vinta nel 2010 (2-0 sul Bayern). Francesi per la prima, dopo il ko in finale contro il Bayern nel 2020 (0-1). TC: Caressa-Bergomi.

programme.title: 1a parte
programme.desc: LA GRANDEZZA. La favola della squadra di Maestrelli, che dalla serie B sfiorò lo scudetto nel 73, per poi vincerlo nel 74, grazie a un allenatore bonario e psicologo.

programme.title: Speciale Calafiori - Gioca, Suona, Sogna
programme.desc: Speciale Calafiori - Gioca, Suona, Sogna.

programme.title: Didier Drogba
programme.desc: History Remix Champions League: Didier Drogba - Le partite memorabili, i gol, le giocate incredibili di Didier Drogba in Champions League raccontate con la colonna sonora di History Remix.

programme.title: Review della finale
programme.desc: Le immagini dei grandi match con i gol e le interviste ai protagonisti del presente e del passato. E le piu' belle storie di questa prestigiosissima competizione continentale.

programme.title: Paris - Liverpool
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League: Paris - Liverpool. Ottavi di Finale Andata. Una vittoria a testa nei due precedenti di Champions del 2018: la vittoria dei Reds ad Anfield (3-2) e il successo del PSG al Parc des Princes (2-1). TC: Marinozzi-Marchegiani.

programme.title: Bayer Leverkusen - Bayern Monaco
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League: Bayer Leverkusen - Bayern Monaco. Ottavi di Finale Ritorno - Rossoneri per ritrovare i quarti di Champions dopo quelli del 2002. Bayern a un passo dai quarti per la sesta volta consecutiva dopo il 3-0 dell’andata. TC: Pietro Nicolodi.

programme.title: Ep. 9
programme.desc: Ep9 - Nel 1996 la Juventus vince la seconda finale della sua storia ai rigori contro l'Ajax. Nel 2002 il Real Madrid batte il Bayer Leverkusen.

programme.title: Feyenoord - Inter
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League: Feyenoord - Inter. Ottavi di Finale Andata - Nei due precedenti europei, le semifinali di Europa League del 2002, il bilancio e' stato di una vittoria del Feyenoord a San Siro e un pareggio in Olanda. TC: Maurizio Compagnoni.

programme.title: Premier League - La vera storia
programme.desc: e' la meta' degli anni '90, la Premier League cresce sempre piu' e una nuova generazione di giocatori impara a gestire la neo trovata fama.

programme.title: Aston Villa - Brugge
programme.desc: Entrambe le formazioni in cerca del secondo quarto europeo consecutivo dopo quello in Conference della scorsa stagione. Gli inglesi hanno vinto 3-1 all'andata. TC: Federico Zancan.

programme.title: Borussia Dortmund - Real Madrid
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League: Borussia Dortmund - Real Madrid. Finale - Tedeschi alla terza finale di UCL: una vinta nel 1997 e una persa nel 2013. Real alla sesta in 11 stagioni con 5 vittorie. Ha vinto gli ultimi 2 precedenti. TC: Zancan-Marchegiani.

programme.title: Seedorf e Ronaldinho
programme.desc: In questa puntata diamo uno sguardo a due dei piu' grandi giocatori che hanno vinto la UEFA Champions League: Clarence Seedorf e Ronaldinho.

programme.title: Aston Villa - Paris
programme.desc: Entrambe per la seconda semifinale europea consecutiva. Aston Villa dopo quella di Conference. PSG dopo quella di Champions League. Ha vinto 3-1 all’andata. TC: Borghi-Montolivo.

programme.title: La magia di Bergkamp
programme.desc: In 30 anni di Premier League ci sono stati tanti gol meravigliosi. Ma solo uno e' poesia in movimento: quello di Dennis Bergkamp al Newcastle.

programme.title: Capitani: gli skipper del calcio
programme.desc: Guidare una squadra e' come timonare una barca: la fascia al braccio da' responsabilita', e la storia del calcio inglese e' piena di giocatori che l'hanno onorata.

programme.title: Milan - Cagliari
programme.desc: Serie A: Milan - Cagliari. 20a g. - Esordio del Milan di Conceicao in campionato. A San Siro ha perso solo 3 volte nei 44 precedenti. Sardi tornati a vincere, 1-2 a Monza, dopo 4 sconfitte. TC: Zancan-Montolivo.

programme.title: Real Madrid - Liverpool 2018
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Story: Real Madrid - Liverpool 2018. Finale - A Kiev la finale tra Real e Liverpool. Zidane punta alla 3a Champions da allenatore, Klopp invece a regalare ai Reds la sesta Coppa della sua storia.

programme.title: Cagliari - Lazio
programme.desc: Serie A: Cagliari - Lazio. 23a g. - Entrambe reduci da un ko con Torino e Fiorentina. I sardi non battono la Lazio da 12 anni, 3 pareggi e 16 sconfitte. Biancocelesti vittoriosi 2-1 all’andata. TC: Marinozzi-Orsi.

programme.title: Premier League - La vera storia
programme.desc: Arsene Wenger arriva a Londra con idee che rivoluzionano il gioco. Quando si scontra con Ferguson, nasce la faida piu' famigerata della storia.

programme.title: Manchester City - Chelsea 2021
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League Story: Manchester City - Chelsea 2021. Finale - Terza finale di Champions League per il Chelsea, 1 vittoria. Prima per i Citizens che non disputavano una finale europea dal 1970. TC: Marianella-Marchegiani.

programme.title: Ep. 1
programme.desc: Ep1 - I momenti che hanno reso unica la Champions League raccontati da chi l'ha vinta: in questo episodio i protagonisti di Real Madrid, Benfica, Liverpool e Milan.

programme.title: Arsenal - PSV
programme.desc: Gunners virtualmente ai quarti di Champions per la seconda stagione consecutiva dopo il 7-1 dell'andata. L'ultima volta del PSV ai quarti 18 anni fa. TC: Ciarravano-Minotti.

programme.desc: In questa puntata diamo uno sguardo a due dei piu' grandi giocatori che hanno vinto la UEFA Champions League: Marcel Desailly e Sergio Ramos.

programme.desc: Tedeschi per la seconda semifinale consecutiva. Hanno perso 4-0 all’andata. Barcellona per ritrovare una semifinale di Champions League dopo 5 stagioni. TC: Gentile-Serena.

programme.desc: Calcio e musica: due grandi passioni legate tra loro da oltre un secolo. Dalla lirica al rock, dai Beatles a Noel Gallagher, dai pezzi unici ai tormentoni.

programme.desc: Serie A: Bologna - Roma. 20a g. - Rossoblù reduci dalla sconfitta interna con il Verona (2-3). Imbattuti negli ultimi 4 precedenti, 3 vittorie e un pareggio. La Roma viene dal 2-0 sulla Lazio. TC: Gentile-Gobbi.

programme.desc: Ep4 - Riviviamo il trionfo in Champions League di Ferguson e Ronaldo nella finale inglese terminata ai rigori tra United e Chelsea e la vittoria della "decima' del Real di Ancelotti nel derby di Madrid.

programme.desc: Premier League: Wolverhampton - Nottingham Forest. 20a g. - 'Lupi' con 7 punti in 3 giornate. Nottingham in zona Champions con una striscia di 5 vittorie consecutive. Quattro pari negli ultimi 4 precedenti di Premier. TC: Massimo Marianella.

programme.desc: UEFA Champions League: Liverpool - Real Madrid. Finale - Ultima finale dei Reds nel 2019, 2-0 sul Tottenham. Ultima del Real nel 2018, 3-1 sul Liverpool. Quinta finale di Champions per Ancelotti. Quarta per Klopp. TC: Marianella-Marchegiani.

programme.desc: Giorgio Porrà racconta l’impresa del Verona 1985. Con le voci di Briegel, Volpati, Tricella, Galderisi, Fanna ed Elkjaer, autori del leggendario scudetto firmato Bagnoli.

programme.title: Ep5

programme.title: Arsenal - PSV

programme.title: Ep. 2

programme.title: Ronaldo e Ibrahimovic

programme.title: Juventus - Atletico M. 12/03/19

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: With his identity as a fugitive businessman exposed, Boss Baby has been hiding out in the lawless land of Canada. programme.title: StreetDance 2
programme.desc: After an embaressing defeat, a street dancer, Ash, assembles the best dancers from all across the world for another around against the Invincible crew.

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: Fleeing the scene of a car crash, Jane and her partner leave a stranger injured on the roadside, only to find themselves plagued by mysterious and unsettling incidents.

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: A team of researchers is in Borneo to find the blood orchid, a flower that could hold the secret to eternal life. However, the scientists run afoul of the jungle's deadly snakes.

programme.title: The Suicide Squad
programme.desc: A group of misfits are coerced to work together for a dangerous mission in Corto Maltese. Despite their differences, they learn to trust each other and collaborate as a team.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: A symbiote bonds with Peter Parker, intensifying his abilities and aggression. Now, he must face the challenges that his new powers bring while simultaneously fighting new villains.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Callum Lynch learns of his ancestor Aguilar de Nerha's ties to a brotherhood of dangerous assassins. So, he travels back in time to acquire their skills and take down a corrupt organisation.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Xerxes, seeking revenge for his father's death, declares war on Greece. As a result, Themistocles, the Athenian admiral, is compelled to form an alliance with Sparta to protect Athens.

programme.title: Alien vs. Predator
programme.desc: The archaeology team from Weyland Industries finds itself trapped between two alien species.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie
programme.desc: Emmet, an ordinary individual prophesied to be the Special, is entrusted with the responsibility of saving the Lego world from the cruel ways of Lord Business.

programme.title: Born to Fight
programme.desc: Dan Barnes, a former professional boxer, takes up the responsibility to coach Matthew Miller, a teenager who is repeatedly bullied by a school boxing champion and his friends.

programme.title: Act of Valor
programme.desc: An elite team of US Navy SEALs is tasked with rescuing a kidnapped CIA operative. However, things become complicated when they come across a much larger global threat in the process.

programme.title: The Starving Games
programme.desc: In a deadly game orchestrated by President Snowballs, skilled archer Kantmiss Evershot, her boyfriend Dale and tech-savvy ally Peter Malarkey must rely on their wits and skills to survive.

programme.title: Absolute Deception
programme.desc: Rebecca Scott, a widowed reporter, teams up with an FBI agent to uncover the mystery of her husband's death. However, things take a turn when they are targeted by unknown enemies.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: While investigating a murder, Alex Cross learns of a ruthless serial killer. However, things soon spiral out of control, leading him on a quest for revenge and uncovering a dark web of conspiracy.

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: A US air marshal receives threatening messages demanding that his airline transfer USD 150 million dollars to an offshore account, in the absence of which the passengers of his flight will be killed.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: Imprisoned at the International Space Station, a group of terrorists manage to escape confinement and take control of the ship. However, their mission to target the Soviets threatens world peace.
